title: Kindness Treasure
moral: Kindness and sharing are the greatest treasures.

scenes.summary: Captain Ben begins a treasure journey with his crew.
scenes.text: Captain Ben and his crew set out to find a treasure marked on a map.
scenes.image_prompt: friendly pirate captain with crew and map on ship cartoon style
scenes.story: Captain Ben sailed with his crew to find treasure. They reached an island and discovered small joyful items instead of gold. They followed a path to a lagoon where a magical light granted wishes. After facing a small storm together, they returned home and shared their treasures with others. They learned that kindness and togetherness are the greatest treasures.
